flagship.headline: ? and the Mysterians hit No. 1 with 96 Tears
flagship.summary_line_1: ? and the Mysterians reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 with 96 Tears on the chart dated October 29, 1966, per the Wikipedia list of 1966 number ones.
flagship.summary_line_2: The garage rock classic held the top spot for one week, and the clip below is the song.

events.headline: King Crimson play their first US show
events.summary_line_1: King Crimson played their first American concert in the refectory at Goddard College in Plainfield, Vermont, on October 29, 1969, per the DGM Live account of Ian McDonald's diary.
events.summary_line_2: It opened a US tour that ran to December 14, and the clip below is 21st Century Schizoid Man from their debut album.

events.headline: The Who release My Generation in the UK
events.summary_line_1: Brunswick released the Who's single My Generation, backed with Shout and Shimmy, in the UK on October 29, 1965, per Wikipedia.
events.summary_line_2: It peaked at No. 2 on the UK chart, and the clip below is the original mono mix.

events.headline: The Rolling Stones open a North American tour in Montreal
events.summary_line_1: The Rolling Stones opened a North American tour at the Montreal Forum on October 29, 1965, per Wikipedia.
events.summary_line_2: The run continued to December 5 in support of Out of Our Heads, and the clip below is Satisfaction.

events.headline: The Beatles close their Swedish tour in Eskilstuna
events.summary_line_1: The Beatles played the sports hall in Eskilstuna, Sweden, on October 29, 1963, the last concert of their Swedish tour, per the Beatles Bible.
events.summary_line_2: About 2,000 people attended, and the clip below is their 1963 single She Loves You.

events.headline: The Beatles tape a second People and Places
events.summary_line_1: The Beatles taped a second appearance on Granada Television's People and Places in Manchester on October 29, 1962, performing Love Me Do and A Taste of Honey, per the Beatles Bible.
events.summary_line_2: It aired in the north of England on November 2, by which time the band was in Hamburg, and the clip below is Love Me Do.
